criteria: One trial per mode, identical fixtures and budgets. Strict success additionally needs independent review of every factual claim, sources, complete deliverables and absence of invented code. Stop without success on failed grounding or missing evidence. Repeat only after credible strict benefit; adoption requires at least 2/3 warm strict successes for every B/E/F/H category and no critical regression. These are predefined equivalents, not recovered historical replay questions.
